title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical fashio
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical fashion portrait of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing outdoors in a dramatic sunlit red-rock desert landscape. Her specific ethnicity or race should remain unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has smooth fair-to-light skin with warm peach undertones and realistic natural texture, a softly tapered oval face, a delicate jawline, straight refined nose, softly arched dark brows, large almond-shaped dark brown eyes with subtle eyeliner and defined lashes, and naturally full coral-pink lips. Her expression is calm, friendly, and softly confident, with a small closed-mouth smile as she looks directly into the camera.

Her hair is very long, straight to gently windswept, and rich medium-to-dark chestnut brown, parted slightly off-center with layered face-framing strands sweeping across her forehead and cheeks. The lengths fall over both shoulders, especially heavily over one side of her chest, reaching well below her waist. She wears medium-sized silver hoop earrings and a long delicate necklace with several small decorative beads and an elongated metallic pendant.

Frame her from approximately mid-thigh upward in a relaxed standing pose. Her torso faces mostly toward the camera with a subtle hip shift. Both elbows are bent naturally at her sides, and both hands are tucked casually into or resting at the front pocket openings of her skirt, creating an easy, self-assured posture.

She wears exactly a fitted sleeveless high-neck cropped top in very pale blush pink with faint narrow horizontal pastel stripes. The top has a high mock-neck collar, exposed shoulders, close body fit, and ends just above the waist, revealing a narrow strip of midriff. Pair it exactly with a high-waisted short plaid mini skirt in dark burgundy, charcoal, muted red, and subtle green tones, with a tailored straight silhouette and visible front pocket openings. Do not add a jacket, sleeves, tights, or any other clothing.

Place her on dusty reddish-orange desert ground scattered with small rocks and dry scrub. Behind her rises a massive rugged formation of weathered rust-red sandstone cliffs and boulders, sharply illuminated by intense midday sunlight. The sky is clear, saturated blue with no visible clouds. Use strong natural sunlight with crisp directional shadows, luminous skin highlights, and slight hair movement from a dry breeze. Shoot with a full-frame camera and approximately 50mm lens at f/2.8–f/4, eye-level perspective, high detail, realistic depth, warm cinematic desert color grading, rich terracotta reds, clean azure blues, subtle contrast, natural skin tones, ultra-real photographic texture, 9:16.
